A '''leather pauldron''' is the [[Leather armor|leather]] [[Armor#Chestplate|chestplate]], crafted from [[Tattered Leather|tattered leather]]. It gives 3 armor and has 200 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/leather_chestplate.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

The vanilla recipe is blocked and replaced by the pack's own, which sets the stats shown in the infobox.

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===

Worn, it gives 3 armor. The vanilla item gives 3 armor with 80 durability.

It adds 1 block of safe fall distance.

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Sturdy Leather|sturdy leather]]. The pack keeps the repair cost at zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely (see [[Repairing]]).
